title: Faerie Blood: Origins and Inheritance
heading: Faerie Blood
requires: Virtue: Faerie Blood or Strong Faerie Blood
summary: Explains how humans come to have Faerie Blood (through faerie procreation, theft of fertility, or influence on a pregnancy or infant) and how the taint is inherited down the generations.
quotes: Faerie Blood manifests regardless of the number of generations between the first character to bear it and the current generation.

title: Varieties of Faerie Blood
heading: Varieties of Faerie Blood
requires: Virtue: Faerie Blood or Strong Faerie Blood
summary: Lists specific kinds of Faerie Blood (bloodcap, brownie, dwarf, ettin, faerie god, ghul, goblin, huldra, nymph, padfoot, satyr, selkie, sidhe, undine), each with its benefit, an enhanced benefit for Faerie Legacy, typical Sympathies, suggested Virtues and Flaws, and appearance.
quotes: Note that this enhanced effect replaces the normal benefit of Faerie Blood, it is not in addition to it.

title: Faerie Powers for the Faerie Blooded
heading: Faerie Powers for the Faerie Blooded
requires: Virtue: Faerie Blood or Strong Faerie Blood (storyguide option)
summary: Optional rule letting a character with Faerie Blood take a restricted list of faerie-only Virtues and Flaws, paying Might costs of their powers in Fatigue rather than Might points.
quotes: instead of spending Might points, the character instead loses 1 Fatigue level for every 5 points (or fraction) of the cost
assume that the character has a Might Score of zero

title: Changelings
heading: Changelings
summary: Introduces how faeries steal or exchange human infants, leaving behind a faerie child, an ancient faerie or a stock, and what results for the child who is retrieved or who is raised by faeries.

title: Retrieved Changelings
heading: Retrieved Changelings
summary: Describes how parents can retrieve a stolen child by tricking the changeling faerie into revealing itself, and what a retrieved child tends to gain, such as Second Sight or Faerie Blood of the kidnappers' variety.

title: Faerie Upbringing (Changelings)
heading: Faerie Upbringing
summary: Explains children raised among faeries, who have the Faerie Upbringing Flaw and usually Faerie Blood, and gives the list of Abilities from which a character with this background has an Ability Block.
quotes: Choose any five Abilities from the following list as unavailable to a character with this Flaw: Animal Handling, Charm, Church Lore, Dominion Lore, Etiquette, Folk Ken, Guile, Leadership, Ride, Theology

title: Linked Lives
heading: Linked Lives
requires: Exchanged with a troll or trowie changeling
summary: Describes a human whose life is bound to the faerie changeling left in his place, represented by Faerie Blood, possibly Faerie Upbringing, and the Death Prophecy Virtue, with a Faerie Friend or Mistaken Identity relationship.
quotes: that the character can only die if his faerie copy is killed first

title: Milk Brothers
heading: Milk Brothers
summary: Describes the bond between a human who has shared milk with a gwiber and the creature: the Animal Ken Virtue and the Faerie Friend Flaw rather than Faerie Blood.

title: Nympholepts
heading: Nympholepts
summary: Describes mortals taken to live with nymphs for years, who gain Faerie Blood effects plus often a prophetic power such as Premonitions, the Visions Flaw or the Faerie Power of Dream.

title: Faerie Virtues and Flaws
heading: Virtues and Flaws
summary: Explains that a Supernatural Virtue can be designated as having a Faerie origin, which gives it the Faerie bonuses on the Realm Interaction Table and spares the character Warping from living in a Faerie aura; notes Benediction and Malediction as typical faerie gifts and curses.
quotes: characters with a Faerie Virtue or Flaw do not gain Warping from living in a Faerie aura.
related: ArM5 pp.54-55 Greater and Lesser Malediction

title: Faerie Ceremony
heading: Ceremony
summary: A Faerie Supernatural Ability that lets a group join a focus character in a faerie effect, adding a group modifier and each participant's Characteristic plus Ability or Method to the focus character's total.
quotes: Group Modifier: total Ceremony scores – number of participants

title: Curse-Throwing
heading: Curse-Throwing
summary: Supernatural Ability to cure diseases, lift curses and dispel harmful effects by transferring them to another person, with a Casting Total against an Ease Factor by affliction type, ritual time, Penetration and modifiers for how the recipient is represented; includes a worked example.
quotes: Curse-Throwing Casting Total: Presence + Curse-Throwing + Aura + stress die
Penetration Total: Casting Total – Ease Factor + Penetration Bonus

title: Learning Faerie Abilities
heading: Learning Faerie Abilities
requires: Strong alignment to the Faerie realm (Sympathy Traits and Faerie Rank)
summary: Describes how characters aligned to Faerie learn Faerie Supernatural Abilities and Arts like Gifted characters learn Magic Abilities, with experience limited by Faerie Rank and easier study of a tradition's four Favored Abilities.
quotes: the sum of the character's strongest positive and negative Sympathy Traits must equal at least 5 at the start of the season for him to learn a new Ability in this way
related: ArM5 p.166 Gifted characters learning Magic Abilities

title: Faerie Doctors as Mythic Companions
heading: Faerie Doctors as Mythic Companions
summary: Character-building rules for playing a faerie doctor, either as a Mythic Companion with the Faerie Doctor Special Virtue and doubled Virtue points per Flaw, or as a Gifted or ordinary character, with compulsory Virtues and Flaws and Favored Abilities.
quotes: receives 2 points to spend on Virtues for every point he spends on Flaws
related: ArM5 p.28 Virtue and Flaw balance

title: Sin-Eating
heading: Sin-Eating
summary: Describes Sin-Eating as a cultural form of Curse-Throwing, in which sins of the dying are treated as afflictions to be transferred, usually onto the practitioner.
quotes: The magnitude of the unforgiven sin should be considered to be a Minor, Serious, or Major Affliction as appropriate.

title: Homunculi Wizards
heading: Homunculi Wizards
requires: Flaw: Homunculus Wizard (character with The Gift)
summary: Explains hedge wizards who gain a faerie version of The Gift through a bond with a homunculus: what they can do, their dependence on feeding and hiding the homunculus, and how to build one as a character.
quotes: To play a Homunculus Wizard as a character, take The Gift and the Homunculus Wizard Flaw during character creation.
related: House Merinita outer mystery of Faerie Magic

title: Faerie Warping
heading: Faerie Warping
requires: Supernatural powers aligned to the Faerie realm
summary: Gives the pattern by which Faerie-aligned characters respond to Warping at each Warping Score, developing a glamour (a Reputation Flaw), a need to act on it or suffer Deprivation, Sympathy Traits, Virtues and Flaws.
quotes: The character must act in a manner concordant with his Reputation at least once a season, or else he suffers the effects of Deprivation

title: Sources of Faerie Warping
heading: Sources of Faerie Warping
summary: Lists how Warping Points are gained from faerie sources: the Faerie realm, powerful Faerie auras and regiones, faerie powers, and botches.
quotes: One Warping Point is gained for every botch die that comes up a zero when using faerie powers or supernatural effects aligned to the Faerie realm.

title: Faerie Calling
heading: Faerie Calling
requires: Faerie Rank and Sympathy Traits, with no magical, divine or infernal tradition
summary: Procedure for the dreamlike Faerie Calling that occurs when a faerie-aligned character gains two or more Warping Points at once: acting during the Calling, designing setting and conflict, a resolution roll, and its effects on Sympathy Traits or permanent departure to Faerie.
quotes: Act During Faerie Calling: stress die + Perception + Awareness vs. ((Warping Score + Warping Points gained) x 3)
Resolve the Faerie Calling: stress die + Perception + Concentration vs. (Warping Score – Faerie Rank) x 3
related: Realms of Power: The Divine p.63 Divine Ascent
Realms of Power: The Infernal p.95 Vituperation

title: Faerie Wizardry Overview
heading: Chapter Six: Faerie Wizardry
summary: Introduces faerie wizards, or faerie hedge wizards, who use faerie rites and faerie bargaining, and the traditions that teach their Abilities and Arts.

title: Rites of Faerie
heading: Rites of Faerie
requires: Faerie Method, Faerie Power and Sympathy Trait
summary: Introduces faerie rites, spontaneous spell-like effects that faerie wizards focus through a Faerie Method and Power.

title: Performing Faerie Rites
heading: Performing Faerie Rites
requires: Faerie Method, Faerie Power and Sympathy Trait
summary: Procedure for casting a faerie rite: the stress die plus Characteristic, Method, Power and aura gives the level, capped by the applicable Sympathy Traits, with rules for negative Traits, botches, experience, ritual-level rites and the lack of permanent effects.
quotes: Rite Casting Total: stress die + Characteristic + Method + Power + aura modifier
Maximum Rite Level: (Sympathy Traits x 5)
related: ArM5 pp.111-114 Hermetic Ranges, Durations and Targets

title: Hermetic Rites
heading: Hermetic Rites
summary: Allows a magus with a Faerie Method and Power to design Hermetic rituals using faerie rite guidelines and the special Faerie Ranges, Durations and Targets, using Method and Power in place of Artes Liberales and Philosophiae.
quotes: the caster may add his scores in the Method and Power instead of Artes Liberales and Philosophiae to his Casting Total

title: Faerie Ranges, Durations, and Targets
heading: Faerie Ranges, Durations, and Targets
requires: Faerie wizard: Faerie Method, Faerie Power and Sympathy Trait
summary: Sidebar of extra Ranges (Crossroads, Presence, Prop, Symbol), Durations (Held, Focus, While, Geas, Hour + 1, Midday/Midnight, Not, Season, Aura, Faerie, Hidden, If, Symbol) and Targets (Medium, Passion, Symbol) available to faerie rites, with their equivalent spell levels and conditions.
quotes: Anyone with a total of 6 or higher is affected.
related: ArM5 pp.111-114 Hermetic Ranges, Durations, Targets
ArM5 pp.92-93 House Merinita Faerie Magic

title: Faerie Methods
heading: Faerie Methods
requires: Faerie wizard: Faerie Method, Faerie Power and Sympathy Trait
summary: Explains that Methods are Supernatural Abilities used with a Faerie Power to perform a rite, and gives guidance for designing new Methods with a Characteristic, a cost and an advantage.

title: Evocation (Faerie Method)
heading: Evocation
summary: Faerie Method using Communication that calls on faerie patrons at the cost of a Warping Point or Confidence Point, and lets the user add vis to any rite for a bonus with a limit and botch risk.
quotes: with each pawn spent increasing his Rite Casting Total by 2.

title: Enchantment (Faerie Method)
heading: Enchantment
summary: Faerie Method using Presence in which the user performs an Ability roll against an Ease Factor tied to the intended magnitude, building up a bonus over several rounds before casting the rite; can also roll a simple die to avoid botching.
quotes: making a roll against an Ease Factor of (the magnitude of the intended effect x 3)

title: Empathy (Faerie Method)
heading: Empathy
summary: Faerie Method using Stamina that requires spending a Fatigue level on a lengthy trance ritual, and lets the user spend more Fatigue to extend the rite, reset bonus limits and multiply the effect cap from Sympathy Traits.
quotes: Empathy allows him to effectively double the value of the Sympathy Traits that determine his effect level

title: Faerie Powers
heading: Faerie Powers
requires: Faerie wizard: Faerie Method, Faerie Power and Sympathy Trait
summary: Explains that Faerie Powers are Supernatural Abilities used only with a Faerie Method, and that each Power has a vulnerability chosen when it is gained.
quotes: Every Faerie Power is vulnerable to certain uncommon circumstances, such as when touching iron, running water, or salt, when in the Dominion, or when repeating the character's name three times.

title: Beguile (Faerie Power)
heading: Beguile
summary: Faerie Power for commanding targets or altering their memories, perceptions and emotions; any Sympathy Trait appropriate to the memory, emotion or perception can apply.

title: Beguile Guidelines
heading: Beguile Guidelines
summary: Spell guideline table by level for Beguile effects: altering memories, perceptions and emotions, planting suggestions, commands and total control.
quotes: Completely control the target, including its movement and communication.

title: Conjure (Faerie Power)
heading: Conjure
summary: Faerie Power creating solid glamours or transforming a target into something else; the caster needs Sympathy Traits for both the original and new forms, and glamours can defy ordinary space and end unpredictably.

title: Conjure Guidelines
heading: Conjure Guidelines
summary: Guideline table for Conjure effects: extra magnitudes for intricate or controllable glamours and for changing animate to inanimate, conjuring faeries, and changing targets into glamours by Size.
quotes: Conjure a faerie with Faerie Might equal to the base level of this effect.

title: Dream (Faerie Power)
heading: Dream
summary: Faerie Power for perceiving things from outside one's body and glimpsing the future; includes advice for storyguides on handling prophetic visions as vague good or bad omens tied to a symbol.

title: Dream Guidelines
heading: Dream Guidelines
summary: Guideline table for Dream effects: remote senses, mental communication, understanding speech, reading thoughts and memories, and answering questions about the likely future over increasing time spans.
quotes: Treat the target as if it possessed the Premonitions Ability for the duration, with a score of (the base level of this effect / 5).

title: Grant (Faerie Power)
heading: Grant
summary: Faerie Power for blessing or cursing a target with Warping Points, temporary Virtues and Flaws, or temporary Sympathy Traits that cannot be increased and do not affect Faerie Rank.
related: Chapter 5: Touches of Faerie, Charms and Sympathetic Influence

title: Grant Guidelines
heading: Grant Guidelines
summary: Guideline table for Grant effects: restoring Faerie Might, giving the target a power, temporary Sympathy Traits, Warping Points, temporary Virtues and Flaws, and temporary Faerie auras or regiones.
quotes: The target faerie regains a number of Faerie Might Points equal to (the base level of this effect + 5) for the duration.

title: Portage (Faerie Power)
heading: Portage
summary: Faerie Power for instant travel by faerie trods, moving the target and what is attached to it from one place to another.

title: Portage Guidelines
heading: Portage Guidelines
summary: Guideline table for Portage effects: moving targets through regio boundaries into or out of the Faerie Realm by level, instant transport to Sympathy Trait objects, and changes to movement speed and Fatigue.
quotes: Transport the target through a regio boundary to a regio with a level less than or equal to ((the base level of this effect + 15) / 5).

title: Ware (Faerie Power)
heading: Ware
summary: Faerie Power for protecting a target with wards against chosen things; wards often need a second Sympathy Trait describing what is warded against, both used for the maximum level, and must penetrate Magic Resistance.
quotes: Use both of these Traits to determine the maximum level of the effect.

title: Ware Guidelines
heading: Ware Guidelines
summary: Guideline table for Ware effects: suppressing supernatural effects, wards against things by Might limit depending on the caster's positive, negative or any Sympathy Traits, and bonuses to Soak and Defense.
quotes: Ward the target against anything associated with one of the caster's positive Sympathy Traits, with Faerie Might no greater than (the base level of this effect + 20).

title: Weal (Faerie Power)
heading: Weal
summary: Faerie Power that alters natural healing and aging for the duration, speeding recovery or slowing aging; cannot return a character to childhood.
quotes: This effect cannot cause a character to revert to childhood, nor can it affect a character who has not yet reached physical maturity.

title: Weal Guidelines
heading: Weal Guidelines
summary: Guideline table for Weal effects: bonuses and penalties to Recovery and Aging rolls, healing wounds for the duration, shortening wound recovery intervals, and reducing apparent age.
quotes: Give the target a bonus to Recovery rolls and a penalty to Aging rolls, or a bonus to Aging rolls and a penalty to Recovery rolls, equal to ((3 + magnitude) x 3)

title: Woe (Faerie Power)
heading: Woe
summary: Faerie Power for inflicting wounds, Fatigue loss, aging and slowed healing that vanish when the effect ends.

title: Woe Guidelines
heading: Woe Guidelines
summary: Guideline table for Woe effects: penalties to Recovery or Aging rolls, Fatigue loss, wounds at each severity for the duration, lengthened wound recovery intervals and forced Aging rolls.
quotes: Give the target a penalty to Recovery or Aging rolls equal to ((3 + magnitude) x 3).

title: Faerie Bargaining (Ars Fabulosa)
heading: Faerie Bargaining
requires: Faerie Bargaining: one of the Virtues Summoning, Bonding, Captivating or Dismissing
summary: Introduces the Ars Fabulosa, the hedge art of bargaining with faeries through four powers (Summoning, Bonding, Captivating, Dismissing) that start at score 0, increase like Arts, and are learned as Supernatural Abilities or from Virtues.
quotes: There are four powers associated with bargaining: Summoning, Bonding, Captivating, and Dismissing.
related: Chapter 5: Touches of Faerie, Learning Faerie Abilities

title: Summoning (Faerie Bargaining)
heading: Summoning
summary: Procedure for summoning a faerie: Sympathy Traits cap the Might that can be summoned, a Fatigue level is spent, a Summoning Total is rolled against the faerie's Might and Magic Resistance, and success holds the faerie to listen and bargain; covers botches, specific faeries, failure, and the experience and penalty for keeping or breaking a bargain.
quotes: Summoning Total: stress die + Presence + Summoning + Faerie Rank + aura Maximum Might
The sum of these Traits, multiplied by 5, determines the maximum Might Score that the character can summon.

title: Summoning Faeries
heading: Summoning Faeries
summary: Sidebar comparing the other Summoning arts that can call faeries or spirits: (Spirit) Summoning, (Elemental) Summoning and Sihr.
related: Realms of Power: The Infernal pp.114-115

title: Bonding (Faerie Bargaining)
heading: Bonding
summary: Power forming a mystic bond with a faerie, using a Bonding Total against the faerie's Might and Magic Resistance, which lets the bearer use the faerie's Characteristics, powers, a shared enchanted effect, or protections from Warping and hardship; bonds to objects need a charm and only one bond can be held at a time.
quotes: Bonding Total: stress die + Communication + Bonding + Faerie Rank + aura
Maximum Might Score: (Sympathy Traits x 5)

title: Faerie Bargains
heading: Faerie Bargains
requires: Faerie Bargaining: one of the Virtues Summoning, Bonding, Captivating or Dismissing
summary: Guidance on conducting a bargaining session with a faerie: working out what it wants with Intelligence + Faerie Lore, roleplaying etiquette, a contested roll to resolve a stalled session, and typical offers and requests.
quotes: you can quickly resolve the bargaining session with a contested Communication + Bargain roll, modified by the character's Faerie Rank.

title: Captivating (Faerie Bargaining)
heading: Captivating
summary: Power for exchanging places with a faerie, with a Captivating Total against the faerie's Might and Magic Resistance; covers what is exchanged, struggles for dominance, and the Warping Points gained.
quotes: Captivating Total: stress die + Perception + Captivating + Faerie Rank + aura

title: Dismissing (Faerie Bargaining)
heading: Dismissing
summary: Power for cancelling effects made by beings with Might, ending effects on them, or releasing them from supernatural agreements, using a Dismissing Total limited by Sympathy Traits; can deflect powers and dismiss several effects with a cumulative penalty.
quotes: Dismissing Total: stress die + Intelligence + Dismissing + Faerie Rank + aura

title: Pagan Traditions
heading: Pagan Traditions
summary: Introduces faerie hedge wizard traditions, with Favored Abilities that are easier to learn, Initiation Scripts, and the minimum Virtue points and Sympathy Traits needed to build a starting faerie wizard.
quotes: the player must devote at least four points of the character's starting Virtues to a Faerie Method and a Faerie Power
related: Chapter 5: Touches of Faerie, Learning Supernatural Abilities

title: Borrowers
heading: Borrowers
summary: Faerie bargaining tradition of travelling traders who sell goods to faeries; Favored Arts are Summoning, Bonding, Captivating and Dismissing.
quotes: Summoning, Bonding, Captivating, Dismissing

title: Ollamhain
heading: Ollamhain
summary: Irish poet-sage tradition of faerie wizardry; Favored Abilities are Enchantment, Beguile, Dream and Portage.
quotes: Enchantment, Beguile, Dream, Portage

title: Volkhvy
heading: Volkhvy
summary: Russian pagan faerie wizards who work communal rites; Favored Abilities are Evocation, Ceremony, Conjure and Grant.
quotes: Evocation, Ceremony, Conjure, Grant

title: Wise Folk
heading: Wise Folk
summary: Village wise men and women who ward off the supernatural and mend or injure; Favored Abilities are Empathy, Ware, Weal and Woe.
quotes: Empathy, Ware, Weal, Woe
